Cancel acts on the selected row. Confirm the other rows continue or remain Done after the action. ### Is an incomplete file saved after I cancel? No usable cloud file should be inferred from **Canceled**. Check Files because a completion can win the timing race immediately before your click; unfinished multipart parts are handled by cleanup and are not listed as a completed item. ### Can I cancel a file after it says Done? No. Done means the upload completed. Use Files to inspect or delete the stored file. ### Can I resume a canceled upload? No. Resume belongs to an Interrupted attempt. Start a new upload from the original if a canceled file is still required. ## Related guides - [Understanding upload progress and transfer states](/uploading/progress-and-states) - [Uploading files and folders](/uploading/files-and-folders) - [Uploading large files with available storage](/uploading/large-files) - [Troubleshooting a failed upload](/troubleshooting/failed-upload)

title: Browse your Dosya audio library in the car
summary: Browse Dosya audio through Apple CarPlay using active-workspace folders, up to 20 recents, 100-item folder pages, depth limits, and phone recovery.
verification: Verified locally against apps/mobile/src/incar/browseScreen.ts, apps/mobile/src/incar/browse.ts, apps/mobile/src/incar/recents.ts, apps/mobile/src/incar/nowPlayingScreen.ts, and apps/mobile/src/incar/carplayNative.ts, and apps/mobile/app.config.ts. Production CarPlay was not road-tested.
body: The CarPlay code path requires iOS 15.1 or later and a Dosya iOS build produced with `DOSYA_CARPLAY=1`. Standard production builds omit the integration while Apple’s restricted CarPlay Audio entitlement remains unavailable, so Dosya does not appear on the vehicle display unless you have an entitlement-enabled build. ### Before you start - First confirm that the installed Dosya build exposes the app in CarPlay. If it does, sign in on the iPhone, select the intended workspace, and connect while parked. - The in-car library is read-only. It does not upload, move, rename, share, or delete files. - Only audio files with `lock_mode` set to `none` become playable rows; folders can still appear even when no eligible audio is inside. ## Steps 1. If Dosya is present on the CarPlay display, open it. When signed out, the root says **Open dosya on your iPhone to sign in**. 2. Choose **Continue Listening** when it appears to resume the current file for that workspace at its saved position. 3. Open **Recent** to browse up to 20 device-saved items for the active workspace. Selecting a recent entry starts it from `0:00` unless it is the current resumable item. 4. Browse a folder to load its direct children. The request retrieves one page of at most 100 items; selecting an audio row queues eligible audio siblings from that returned level and starts the chosen track. 5. Use native **Now Playing** for playback. Dosya opens it while a selection is playing or buffering. 6. Stop at the supported navigation depth. After root plus three pushed folder levels, the next view reports **Too many nested folders - browse this on your iPhone**. ### Recovery A 401 response says **Reconnect on your iPhone to keep browsing.** Other listing failures say **Couldn't load your files. Check your connection.** Reauthenticate or restore the phone connection while parked, then reopen the CarPlay template. A deleted or inaccessible saved recent can silently fail to open and is only logged by the app. Verify it in phone **Files** and choose another entry. Signing out clears the local recent history. ## Expected result In an entitlement-enabled build, the selected unlocked audio file enters native Now Playing with eligible siblings from its loaded folder level. Browsing and playback leave the cloud library unchanged. ## Related guides - [Browse backed-up files on mobile](/files/mobile-browse-files) - [Preview media files](/files/media-preview-controls)

title: Use Now Playing controls in the car
summary: Control active Dosya audio through CarPlay, understand queue and metadata behavior, and recover safely when streaming or session access fails.
verification: Verified locally against apps/mobile/src/incar/nowPlayingScreen.ts, apps/mobile/src/player/controller.ts, apps/mobile/src/player/service.ts, and apps/mobile/src/player/metadata/triggers.ts on 2026-10-14; production vehicle controls were not exercised.
body: CarPlay uses Apple's shared Now Playing screen for an active Dosya audio session. Dosya supplies queue and metadata; the vehicle determines layout. ## Playback behavior This is iOS-only and requires Apple's CarPlay audio entitlement. The template opens for Playing or Buffering. Dosya disables its Up Next and album-artist buttons. The service advertises play, pause, next, previous, and seek. Remote Next wraps at a populated queue's end. Active and next tracks get live URLs; later ones resolve when needed. Folder queues contain unlocked audio only and cap at 500. Title, artist, artwork, progress, and state use the native media center. Filename without final extension and folder/source name are fallbacks. Cached ID3 or MP4 tags can replace title, artist, and artwork. ## Steps 1. Park, connect iPhone, and open **dosya**. 2. Choose unlocked audio and wait through buffering. 3. Open Now Playing and verify its title. 4. Test Pause, Play, and seek when exposed. 5. In a multi-track queue, use Next and verify audio plus metadata. 6. Put the phone away before driving. ## Expected result Car and phone control one native session, so transport changes affect the same queue without modifying cloud files. On failure, Dosya resolves a fresh URL and retries once at the prior position. If that fails, the phone says **Couldn't play "title" - skipping.** and advances when possible. Cached audio may survive an outage; uncached items need access. ## Troubleshooting - **Now Playing never opens.** Start audio first. - **Up Next is absent.** Dosya explicitly disables it. - **Only a filename appears.** Let caching and tag extraction finish. - **Dosya is absent from the car.** Confirm an entitled iOS build and supported CarPlay; Android Auto is not implemented here. ## Related guides - [Media preview controls](/files/media-preview-controls) - [Browse files on mobile](/files/mobile-browse-files)

title: Open recently played Dosya audio
summary: Use CarPlay’s root history rows on iPhone, distinguish resumed from restarted audio, and recover when a saved cloud track is no longer reachable.
verification: Verified locally against apps/mobile/src/incar/browseScreen.ts, apps/mobile/src/incar/recents.ts, apps/mobile/src/incar/historyHooks.ts, and apps/mobile/src/incar/browseScreen.test.ts on 2026-10-14; production CarPlay hardware was not connected.
body: Dosya places playback history at the top of its CarPlay root list. There is no separate **Recents** screen or button. ## How history works CarPlay is iPhone-only and needs Apple's audio entitlement plus a restorable signed-in session and active workspace. When audio becomes active, Dosya stores its identity and source locally. Position checkpoints update every 2 seconds. The device keeps at most 20 recent file IDs across all workspaces, then displays only entries for the active workspace. **Continue Listening** resumes the single current item at its positive saved position. Other history rows begin at 0:00. Both fetch one selected file and play it alone; neither reconstructs the earlier folder queue. ## Steps 1. While parked, connect iPhone and open **dosya** in CarPlay. 2. Confirm the phone's active workspace. A missing session shows **Open dosya on your iPhone to sign in**. 3. Choose **Continue Listening** to use its stored checkpoint. 4. Select a following history row to restart that track. 5. Confirm the title in Now Playing before driving. ## Expected result Continue Listening seeks after opening its file, while a normal recent row begins at zero. Neither changes cloud data. Signing out clears both history tables so another account cannot see them. Deleted, inaccessible, or offline saved tracks produce no CarPlay modal; the tap is a no-op. A stale row can remain until newer listening exceeds the 20-entry cap or account data is purged. ## Troubleshooting - **No history appears.** Play unlocked audio on the phone, confirm workspace, and reconnect. - **Resume is slightly behind.** Persistence follows the 2-second progress interval. - **A row does nothing.** Check phone connectivity and file reachability. - **The sign-in row appears.** Restore the session on iPhone. ## Related guides - [Media preview controls](/files/media-preview-controls) - [Browse files on mobile](/files/mobile-browse-files)

title: Search Dosya audio from the car display
summary: Use Dosya’s Siri-only in-car audio lookup, learn its exact-match decision rules, and diagnose silent ambiguous, empty, or signed-out results.
verification: Verified locally against apps/mobile/src/incar/search.ts, voice.ts, apps/mobile/src/player/queue.ts, controller.ts, apps/mobile/src/files/api.ts, and apps/api/src/pages/api/search.ts on 2026-10-14; production Siri and CarPlay were not invoked.
body: Dosya has no typed **Search** control or CarPlay search template. In-car lookup is a Siri intent that searches the active workspace and plays only one unambiguous audio result. ## Search rules The native Siri bridge accepts a query while running or cold-launched. Dosya hydrates the saved session before reading active workspace. Workspace search requires the role's `access_files` permission and returns at most 50 file hits and 50 folder hits on its default first page. Dosya retains matching folders but filters files to recognised audio. The voice resolver attempts playback only for exactly one audio file and zero folder matches, making a one-track queue labelled **Search results**. Multiple audio results, one audio plus a folder, or folders without audio are ambiguous. Zero folders and audio is no match. The listener provides no fallback list or announcement, so both outcomes leave playback unchanged. This Siri path requests no second page, so matches beyond the first 50 file hits or first 50 folder hits cannot affect that decision. The sole audio hit must also be unlocked. Search can return a file whose own `lock_mode` is set, and the current voice resolver still reports that case internally as `played`; the player then drops the locked track, leaves playback unchanged, and shows **This file can't be played.** on the phone. ## Steps 1. Sign in on iPhone, choose the intended workspace, and use a role with `access_files` permission. 2. Pick a distinctive fragment of one unlocked audio filename that is not also a folder name. 3. While parked, invoke the Dosya Siri audio intent and speak it. 4. Wait for the unique match to begin. 5. Compare Now Playing with the expected filename. 6. If silent, refine the phrase later or browse folders instead of interacting while driving. ## Expected result One unlocked audio result without a folder collision starts as a solo queue. Search does not alter any item. A signed-out launch, empty query, absent workspace, API failure, ambiguity, or no match leaves playback unchanged. Errors are logged on the phone rather than shown as a CarPlay alert. ## Troubleshooting - **No Search button exists.** Use Siri; typed in-car search is absent. - **A precise title does nothing.** Look for a matching folder, a second audio filename, or a result outside the first 50 hits. - **The phone says This file can't be played.** The sole matching audio file is locked; unlock it in Files before trying the Siri query again. - **Search returns nothing for this role.** Ask a workspace administrator for `access_files`, or switch to a role that already has it. - **Wrong workspace is searched.** Change the phone's active workspace first. - **Cold launch stays silent.** Restore sign-in and retry while parked. - **A PDF matches the words.** Non-audio files are filtered out. ## Related guides - [Media preview controls](/files/media-preview-controls) - [Browse files on mobile](/files/mobile-browse-files)

title: Use voice control with Dosya audio
summary: Use Siri media search for one uniquely matched Dosya audio file, with active-workspace, ambiguity, no-result, cold-launch, and safety limits explained.
verification: Verified locally against apps/mobile/src/incar/voice.ts, apps/mobile/src/incar/search.ts, apps/mobile/modules/dosya-siri-search/ios/SiriSearchModule.swift, apps/mobile/modules/dosya-siri-search/ios/DosyaPlayMediaIntentHandler.swift, apps/mobile/src/incar/carplayNative.ts, and apps/mobile/app.config.ts. Production Siri recognition was not road-tested.
body: The Siri media-intent code path is included only in a Dosya iOS build produced with `DOSYA_CARPLAY=1`. Standard production builds omit it while Apple’s restricted CarPlay Audio entitlement remains unavailable. In an entitlement-enabled build, the bridge passes the spoken media, artist, or album text to active-workspace search. ### Before you start - Confirm the installed Dosya build exposes its Siri media integration, then sign in on the iPhone and select the correct workspace before connecting to the vehicle. - Choose a uniquely searchable audio filename or path phrase. Search is based on Dosya results; it does not semantically match the browser's parsed artist or album tags. - Practice while parked. The integration has no on-screen ambiguity picker or spoken recovery implemented by the JavaScript handler. ## Steps 1. Verify the intended audio object in phone **Files** and note a distinctive part of its stored name. 2. In an entitlement-enabled build, invoke Siri's media playback for Dosya using that unique phrase. Exact wording can vary with the device's Siri language and available app vocabulary. 3. Dosya restores the mobile session and reads the last active workspace. A cold-launch request is retained until the JavaScript handler is ready; a request while running arrives as an event. 4. Search filters file results by audio kind, but it does not filter locked results. With exactly one audio file and zero folders, Dosya asks the player for a one-track **Search results** queue. A playable unlocked file starts; a locked or otherwise ineligible result is removed by queue construction, does not start, and can show **This file can't be played.** 5. Check native Now Playing for the intended title. If nothing starts, first inspect the file on the phone for a lock or playback refusal; then confirm the active workspace and make the search phrase more distinctive if the result was ambiguous. ### No result, ambiguity, and errors Zero matching files and folders produces no playback and no user-visible explanation. A unique locked or otherwise unplayable audio result can show **This file can't be played.**, although the voice resolver internally returns `played` after asking the player to start it. Search errors are written only to the app log. More than one file, or even one folder alongside one file, is treated as ambiguous and also does not play. An empty query, missing active workspace, or signed-out session ends without action. The voice action does not rename, move, delete, or edit the audio. Renaming a cloud file to improve uniqueness is a separate persistent operation and can affect links or collaborators, so prefer a distinctive test item before changing production names. ## Expected result In an entitlement-enabled build, one unique playable and unlocked audio result begins in a single-item queue. Ambiguous, empty, signed-out, failed, locked, or otherwise unplayable results require phone-side verification. ## Related guides - [Browse the CarPlay audio library](/files/carplay-browse-library) - [Browse backed-up files on mobile](/files/mobile-browse-files)

title: Change your account display name
summary: Update the Full name field for every workspace, understand the 80-character limit, and verify the saved name without changing your email or password.
verification: Reviewed locally with apps/web/src/pages/profile/identity.tsx, apps/api/src/pages/api/me/name.ts, packages/shared/src/validation/policy.ts, and apps/api/src/pages/api/me/name.unit.test.ts. No request reached production services or an identity provider.
body: Your Dosya display name is the **Full name** under **Profile → Identity**. It is visible to teammates across all workspaces, so one save changes the name associated with this account everywhere it is displayed. It does not modify the account email, sign-in password, workspace ownership, or file ownership. Names may use spaces, apostrophes, hyphens, and Unicode scripts. Dosya trims surrounding whitespace, removes invisible formatting characters, normalizes the stored text, and allows at most **80 characters**. An empty or invisible-only value returns **Name is required**; an over-limit value returns **Name is too long (max 80 chars)**. ## Steps 1. Open **Profile → Identity**. On the compact web layout, open **Profile** and choose **Identity**. 2. Confirm the email shown beneath the current name so you edit the intended account. 3. In **Full name**, enter the name teammates should see. Keep the normalized result within 80 characters. 4. Select **Save** beside the field. 5. Wait for the confirmation **Saved — Your name has been updated.** 6. Reload **Identity** and open a workspace where another member can see your account name. ## What changes after saving The updated value is written to the user account and cached identity records for browser and mobile authentication are invalidated. The next identity read can therefore return the new name across clients. Existing sessions remain signed in. The name may appear in workspace member lists, invitations, sharing activity, or other collaborative views. Because it is an account property, you cannot assign a different personal display name to each workspace. ## Troubleshooting If nothing happens when **Save** is selected, remove whitespace-only content. For a rejected long name, shorten it to 80 characters or fewer. A failed request appears as **Update failed** followed by the server message, or **The change could not be saved.** when no specific reason is available. If the old name remains in one open view, refresh that view after the success toast. If the email changed or a verification code is requested, you are using the separate email-change control; cancel that flow before continuing. ## Expected result The new display name appears after refresh and in collaborative account surfaces, while the sign-in email and active sessions remain unchanged. ## Related guides - [Update profile settings](/account/profile-settings) - [Review sessions](/account/sessions)

title: Choosing the web, desktop or mobile app
summary: Choose the Dosya app that fits browser file management, background folder sync or phone backup, and check current platform availability before installing.
verification: Reviewed the production Dosya web, desktop and mobile download pages on 2026-10-12. The captures confirmed current desktop downloads for Windows, macOS and Linux; Android availability through Google Play, AppGallery and a direct APK; Android 7.0 or later; and the iPhone app still in App Store review for iOS 16 or later. Web-app task guidance was checked against the current local web navigation and upload flows. Store installation, an iPhone beta and background sync on physical devices were not exercised for this article. Visual and repeated copy reviewed against this guide’s existing task instructions and screenshot subject; migration: apps/help/scripts/rewrite-task-copy.mjs. No product behavior or image assets changed.
body: Use the same Dosya account across the web app, desktop app and available mobile app. Choose by the job you need to do: the web app is the quickest way to manage files from a browser, the desktop app adds background folder sync, and the mobile app handles phone access and photo backup. You can use more than one. Installing the desktop or mobile app does not create a separate storage area; select the same account and workspace to reach the same cloud files. ## Before you start - Know which device and operating-system version you will use. - Sign in to your existing Dosya account, or [create and verify an account](/account/create-and-verify-account) first. - Check the official [desktop download page](https://dosya.dev/desktop/) or [mobile page](https://dosya.dev/mobile/) at installation time. Versions, store listings and supported systems can change after this guide is reviewed. - If you use a managed work or school device, confirm that its administrator permits software installation, background sync and access to your chosen workspace. ## Steps: choose the right app 1. Choose the **web app** when you need immediate browser access, one-off uploads, file organization, sharing, workspace management or settings. 2. Choose the **desktop app** when a folder on Windows, macOS or Linux should continue syncing in the background, or when you regularly move files between the computer and Dosya. 3. Choose the **Android app** for files on a phone or tablet and automatic photo and video backup. Install it through an official store when possible. 4. For an iPhone or iPad, check the current mobile page before planning an install. At this review date, the iPhone app is still in App Store review and cannot yet be installed from a public App Store listing. 5. Sign in, choose the intended workspace and confirm its name before uploading or enabling sync or backup. ## Compare the apps | Need | Best starting point | Why | | --- | --- | --- | | Open Dosya without installing software | **Web app** | Runs in a current browser and covers uploads, files, sharing, workspaces, integrations and settings. | | Upload a file or folder once | **Web app** | Opens immediately and shows transfer progress in the Uploads page. | | Keep a computer folder synchronized | **Desktop app** | Adds continuous background sync and desktop transfer controls. | | Work across Windows, macOS or Linux | **Desktop app** | Dosya publishes downloads for all three platforms from one page. | | Back up phone photos and videos | **Android app** | The released mobile app supports automatic media backup from Android. | | Save a page or browser download quickly | **Browser extension** | Connects a supported browser to your account; see the separate extension guide. | | Use an iPhone or iPad today | **Web app in Safari** | The public iPhone app is still in review as of 2026-10-12. Check the mobile page for a later release. | ### Web app Open [app.dosya.dev](https://app.dosya.dev/) from a current browser. This is the simplest choice on a shared or temporary computer because there is no app to install. Sign out when finished on a device you do not control and avoid saving your password in its browser. The web app is also the clearest place to review workspace names, storage usage, members, share links and integrations. See [Web app navigation](/account/navigate-web-app). ### Desktop app The production download page detects the computer platform and keeps links to the other desktop builds visible. At this review date, the published minimums are Windows 10 or later on 64-bit x64, macOS 12 or later, and 64-bit x64 releases based on Ubuntu 22.04+, Fedora 38+ or Debian 12+. The macOS page states whether the current download supports Apple Silicon, Intel or both. Use the live page as the final source because build availability can change. See [Installing the desktop app](/desktop/install-and-sign-in) and [Syncing a desktop folder](/desktop/sync-folder) for setup. ### Mobile app Android 7.0 or later is the published minimum. Google Play is the usual choice because the store manages updates; AppGallery is available for supported Huawei devices. A direct APK is offered for people who cannot use either store, but Android will ask for permission to install it and future updates may need manual action. The iPhone card lists iOS 16 or later as the intended minimum, but the app remains in App Store review at this review date. Do not install a file or profile from an unofficial link claiming to be the Dosya iPhone app. ## Expected result You use the surface suited to the task, sign in with the same account and see the intended workspace. Browser actions appear in the web app, desktop sync runs from the selected local folder, and Android backup sends media to the workspace chosen in the mobile app. ## Limits and availability The web app needs a compatible browser and a connection while performing cloud actions. Background behavior in browsers can be paused by the operating system, so use the desktop app for continuous folder sync. The desktop and Android apps must meet the operating-system requirements shown on their current download pages. Store publication varies by platform and country. An announced or review-stage app is not available until its official listing offers an install button. ## Troubleshooting **The download page recommends the wrong desktop system.** Use the visible Windows, macOS or Linux link to switch platforms. Confirm the file type and system requirement before opening it. **A desktop installer will not open.** Confirm the operating-system version and processor architecture. Download a fresh copy from the official page, then follow [Installing the desktop app](/desktop/install-and-sign-in). **Google Play says the Android device is incompatible.** Check that it runs Android 7.0 or later and that the store is signed into the intended account. Use AppGallery only on a supported device, or the official direct APK when your device permits it. **There is no iPhone install button.** The page is reporting availability accurately. Use the web app in Safari and check the [mobile page](https://dosya.dev/mobile/) later rather than using an unofficial download. **Files differ between two apps.** Confirm the account and active workspace in both. A desktop sync folder and an Android backup destination can point at a different workspace from the one open in the browser. ## Frequently asked questions ### Do I need a different account for each app? No. Sign in with the same Dosya account and choose the intended workspace. ### Can I use only the web app? Yes. Use the desktop app when you need background folder sync and the Android app when you need phone backup or mobile access. ### Is the iPhone app available now? At the 2026-10-12 review it is still in App Store review. The [live mobile page](https://dosya.dev/mobile/) is the current source after that date. ### Should I install the direct Android APK? Prefer Google Play or AppGallery when available because the store manages installation and updates. Use only the APK linked from Dosya's official mobile page when a store is unavailable. ## Related guides - [Web app navigation](/account/navigate-web-app) - [Installing the desktop app](/desktop/install-and-sign-in) - [Syncing a desktop folder](/desktop/sync-folder) - [Connecting the browser extension](/extension/install-and-connect)

The static fallback capacities are Free 5 GB, Starter 100 GB, Plus 500 GB, Pro 1 TB, and Business 2 TB. ## Steps 1. Open **Billing** and read owned-workspace usage plus **Total limit**. 2. Select **Choose a plan** without a subscription, or **Change plan** with one. Compare the cards and their included storage. 3.
